# GHOST SIGNAL — WHAT IF?
> Biomedical AI Reliability Research & Telemetry Simulation Platform
> Optic Forge Hackathon

Test the reliability of AI when patient data cannot be trusted.

## About This System
GHOST SIGNAL is an experimental research platform exploring how vital-sign data quality, missing readings, stale timestamps, and sensor noise affect machine learning risk scores. It compares a Baseline Random Forest (using all eligible features) against a Random Forest using Genetic Algorithm (GA)-selected features under adversarial telemetry perturbations.

## Safety & Epistemic Boundaries
- RESEARCH DEMONSTRATION ONLY: Not for diagnosis, triage, treatment, or real-patient decisions.
- Risk scores are uncalibrated statistical model outputs and must not be described as validated clinical probabilities.
- All default demo records are marked: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA — NOT CLINICAL EVIDENCE.
- Feature importance reflects statistical tree splits and does not establish biological or clinical causation.

## Key APIs & Machine-Readable Interfaces
- Base URL: /api
- Interactive Documentation: /docs
- OpenAPI 3.1 JSON Specification: /openapi.json
- Health & Model Status: GET /api/health
- Cohort Telemetry Summary: GET /api/dashboard/summary
- Patient Records: GET /api/records?limit=50&quality_status=CLEAN
- Data Quality Audit: GET /api/data-quality/report
- Model Comparison: GET /api/models/comparison?threshold=0.50
- WHAT IF Simulator: POST /api/simulator/what-if
- Experiment History: GET /api/experiments
- Experiment Export: GET /api/experiments/export-csv

## Simulated Perturbation Modes
1. Gaussian Sensor Noise: Adds noise N(0, sigma^2 * std) across physiological features.
2. Sensor Dropout: Simulates probe detachment (SpO2, BP, etc.) forcing model imputation.
3. Stale Timestamps: Simulates buffered telemetry drift (>120 minutes).
4. Ghost Signal Detection: Identifies Silent Failures (false negatives) and Spurious Alarms (false positives).

## UN Sustainable Development Goals
- SDG 3 (Target 3.8): Minimizing hospital telemetry alarm fatigue and preventing silent patient decompensation.
- SDG 9 (Target 9.5): Fault-tolerant AI infrastructure resilient to edge sensor degradation in low-resource clinics.
- SDG 10 (Future Roadmap): Subgroup reliability auditing across demographic partitions.
